scripts.text: Eh! Can't and old man walk in peace anymore?!
scripts.translation: 咦！連老人家都不能安安靜靜走路了嗎？！

scripts.text: My wife wants me home?! Alright, alright... I'm going, I'm going. Thank you for telling me the message.
scripts.translation: 我老婆叫我回家？！好啦好啦...我這就回去。謝謝你幫忙傳話。

scripts.text: Sorry can't talk, I'm a busy man, I'm waiting for my package.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙，正在等包裹，沒空聊天。

scripts.text: Weren't you supposed to deliver me a box? Where is it?
scripts.translation: 你不是要給我送箱子嗎？箱子呢？

scripts.text: Ahh, you must be from the Treasure Hunter Agency. Do you have my bow??
scripts.translation: 啊，你一定是尋寶者公會派來的。我的弓帶來了嗎？

scripts.text: Ahh, good,thank you for your time. Take this Treasure Token.
scripts.translation: 啊，太好了，謝謝你跑這一趟。拿著這個尋寶代幣。

scripts.text: Arrrg!... Those Bastard Bugs have eaten everything, this place doesn't even look like my farm anymore!!
scripts.translation: 啊啊啊！那些該死的蟲子把東西全吃光了，這裡看起來都不像我的農場了！！

scripts.text: Ohhh, thank you thats a good start for me.
scripts.translation: 哦，謝謝你，這對我來說是個好開端。

scripts.text: Well those bugs can bugger off...
scripts.translation: 那些蟲子最好都滾遠點...

scripts.text: Well here take these 2 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.translation: 那些該死的蟲子到處都是！！！

scripts.text: You must be from the guild! OK, bring me 20 Worm Peelings, 20 Jellopies, 20 fluff and 20 Clovers.
scripts.translation: 你一定是公會派來的！好，帶給我20個蝴蝶幼蟲皮、20個傑勒比結晶、20個絨毛和20個四葉草。

scripts.text: This is my husbands grave... I'm just paying him a little visit.
scripts.translation: 這是我丈夫的墳墓...我只是來看看他。

scripts.text: Thank you sooo much here have these 3 Treasure Tokens.
scripts.translation: 太感謝你了，拿著這3枚尋寶代幣吧。

scripts.text: So your the one that has come to help me?
scripts.translation: 所以你就是來幫我的人？

scripts.text: Ok well this is what I wanted you to do, this greave beside me is my husbands grave and I promised him that I would bury some Mementos with him, The problem is that I have no Mementos...
scripts.translation: 好，我想請你幫忙。這旁邊是我丈夫的墳墓，我答應過要埋些紀念品陪著他。可我手上沒有紀念品...

scripts.text: What's that? You have a letter for me!!
Oooooh I just love,love letters :D. next here will I open it.
scripts.translation: 哦哦哦，我最喜歡情書了 :D。我這就開啟看看。

scripts.text: Sorry to inform you but you have been evicted, please move out within 3-5 days.
scripts.translation: 很遺憾通知你，你已被房東要求搬離，請在3到5天內遷出。

scripts.text: Oh... um... Well fuck, that bastard thinks he can kick me out!!!!! He's got another thing coming!
scripts.translation: 哦...呃...該死，那個混蛋以為能把我趕出去嗎！！他等著瞧吧！

scripts.text: Well thank you for delivering this anyway have this Treasure Token.
scripts.translation: 總之謝謝你送信，拿著這枚尋寶代幣吧。

scripts.text: So your the one that has a letter for me?
scripts.translation: 你就是來給我送信的人嗎？

scripts.text: Its so boring when you have to next on people...
scripts.translation: 總是催別人做事真無聊...

scripts.text: Ahh hello, you must be from the Treasure Hunter Guild.
scripts.translation: 啊，你好，你一定是尋寶者公會的人。

scripts.text: Do you have my Jur? Ahh good good. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 我的短劍帶來了嗎？啊，很好很好，謝謝你。

scripts.text: Here have this Treasure Hunter Token.
scripts.translation: 拿著這枚尋寶者代幣吧。

scripts.text: So your the one that is supposed to bring my Jur?
scripts.translation: 你就是要給我送短劍的人嗎？

scripts.text: Hello, sorry I don't have much time to talk I'm waiting for someone.
scripts.translation: 你好，抱歉我沒時間聊天，我正在等人。

scripts.text: Oh hello, OH you have my honey, my bees and I thank you.
scripts.translation: 哦，你好。啊，你帶來了蜂蜜，我和我的蜜蜂都很感謝你。

scripts.text: Here have these 2 Treasure Hunter Tokens.
scripts.translation: 拿著這2枚尋寶者代幣吧。

scripts.text: Hello, my name is Lenith and I have a quest for you.
scripts.translation: 你好，我叫萊妮絲，有個任務要交給你。

scripts.text: Well recently a bunch of stupid bears stole the supers off all my bee's nests...Stupid bears.
scripts.translation: 最近一群蠢熊偷走了我所有蜂巢裡的蜂蜜...真是蠢熊。

scripts.text: What I need you to do is find me some more honey so these bee's can get through the winter. I will need about 20 Honey.
scripts.translation: 我需要你再幫我找些蜂蜜，好讓蜜蜂們熬過冬天。大約需要20個蜂蜜。

scripts.text: Sorry can't talk, I'm waiting for someone.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我在等人，沒空聊天。

scripts.text: I knew you looked strong, I have no idea how you could have killed that monster though.
scripts.translation: 我就知道你很強，不過真想不到你是怎麼打倒那隻魔物的。

scripts.text: thank you so much, here have these 3 Guild Tokens as a reward.
scripts.translation: 太感謝你了，拿著這3枚公會代幣作為報酬。

scripts.text: Wow you must be the brave man from the treasure hunter guild!
scripts.translation: 哇，你一定是尋寶者公會派來的勇者！

scripts.text: Ok here is whats happening, I don't know what started it but there is a strange Ronan Skeleton running around the woods 2 East from here.
scripts.translation: 事情是這樣的，我也不知道原因，但這裡往東兩張地圖的森林裡有一隻奇怪的羅南骷髏在遊蕩。

scripts.text: We have try to kill him in the past but it was not...ummm...It was a bad idea. What I want you to do is go there and bring me back his Skull as proof of you killing him.
scripts.translation: 我們以前試著殺過它，但那...嗯...不是個好主意。我要你去那裡殺了它，把它的頭骨帶回來作證。

scripts.text: Love to chat, but I'm waiting for someone.
scripts.translation: 我很樂意聊天，不過我正在等人。

scripts.text: Ok well this is a start.
I hope that this hole will go away 1 day, and I might have another quest for you in the future.
scripts.translation: 希望有一天這個洞會消失，到時候我或許還有別的任務交給你。

scripts.text: You must be from the Treasure Hunter Guild.
scripts.translation: 你一定是尋寶者公會派來的。

scripts.text: Ok well this is my problem, yah see that hole in the ground? Yah that thing just popped out of nowhere a couple years ago, inside its full of these ugly ants and these monsters called Giearths.
scripts.translation: 嗯，事情是這樣的。看到地上的洞了嗎？那東西幾年前突然出現，裡面全是難看的螞蟻，還有叫做基爾瑟的魔物。

scripts.text: What I want you to do is kill some of the Giearths.Bring me 30 of there little Moustaches.
scripts.translation: 我要你殺掉一些基爾瑟，帶回30根它們的小鬍鬚。

scripts.text: Sorry I'm waiting for my package so I don't want to talk.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我在等包裹，不想聊天。

scripts.text: Perfect right on time, now I must be going to plant this bomb.... Err I mean give this package to my mother for her birthday.
scripts.translation: 來得正是時候，我得去安放這個炸彈...呃，我是說把包裹送給媽媽當生日禮物。

scripts.text: Live doesn't get any worse for me, working in this bug filled Culvert every day...
scripts.translation: 每天在滿是蟲子的下水道工作...日子真是糟透了。

scripts.text: Well that looked like it was no trouble for you.
scripts.translation: 看起來這對你來說輕而易舉。
謝謝你，拿著這4枚尋寶代幣。

scripts.text: For a while now we have had monster, mostly bugs infesting the culvert...
scripts.translation: 最近一段時間，下水道里一直有魔物出沒，大多是蟲子...

scripts.text: What I want you to do is kinda clean some of it out, every little bit counts.
scripts.translation: 我想請你幫忙清理一些，能清多少算多少。

scripts.text: Danger, the Coal Mine is now a hostile area.
scripts.translation: 危險，煤礦現在已成為敵對區域。

scripts.text: Well its good to see that you have come back alive.
scripts.translation: 很高興看到你平安回來了。

scripts.text: I had my doubts but thank you for your help.
scripts.translation: 我原本有些懷疑，不過還是謝謝你的幫忙。

scripts.text: Hello, you must be from the Treasure Hunter Guild.
scripts.translation: 你好，你一定是尋寶者公會派來的。

scripts.text: They must have filled you in on what is happening on the lower levels of this Coal Mine, I know its disturbing and we are still trying to figure out why and how 2 Evil Druids got down there.
scripts.translation: 他們應該告訴你煤礦下層發生了什麼。我知道這很令人不安，我們還在調查兩隻邪惡德魯伊為何、又是如何下去的。

scripts.text: Well what I want you to do is bring me 50 Lantern's as proof that you have cleaned some of them out, any loot you find down there you may keep other then what I have asked you to get for me.
scripts.translation: 我要你帶回50個燈籠，證明你清理過一部分魔物。除了我指定要的東西，下面找到的戰利品都歸你。

scripts.text: Well hello be careful in the cave, we have heard reports of Undead monster funning around.
scripts.translation: 你好，在洞穴裡小心點，我們聽說有不死魔物在四處遊蕩。

scripts.text: Welcome back, good job you did it. (I wonder if that Flaming Bastard is still alive)
scripts.translation: 歡迎回來，做得好。（不知道那個火焰混蛋還活著沒有。）

scripts.text: Well I hope that cut down a bit on the monsters and here have these 2 Tokens.
scripts.translation: 希望魔物少了一些。拿著這2枚代幣吧。

scripts.text: Well this is what I need you to do, bring me 50 Decayed Nails - a while back Payon Cave used to be a safe place to go...But now things have gone out of control and Zombies have invaded the first floor...
scripts.translation: 我需要你帶來50個腐爛的釘子。以前斐揚洞窟還很安全...但現在情況失控，殭屍佔據了一樓...

scripts.text: There is also these new monsters that have just popped out of no were, we call them Flaming Bastards...Be careful if you aren't powerful yet because they are very strong.
scripts.translation: 還出現了一種不知從哪兒冒出來的新魔物，我們叫它們火焰混蛋...如果你還不夠強就要小心，它們很厲害。

scripts.text: Get out of my face you flake.
scripts.translation: 從我眼前消失，你這廢物。

scripts.text: Dear god took you long enough you bastard!
You know how much my time is worth!!!!
scripts.translation: 你知道我的時間有多寶貴嗎！！！！

scripts.text: Your slow and I'm never gonna recommend a job for you, Gimmie my staff and get out of me face!
scripts.translation: 你太慢了，我絕不會給你介紹工作。把我的法杖還我，然後滾開！

scripts.text: Well you can take this crappy Treasure Token.
scripts.translation: 拿著這枚破爛的尋寶代幣吧。

scripts.text: Yes! Now my pet will not starve!
scripts.translation: 太好了！我的寵物不會捱餓了！

scripts.text: You have come to help me? Yes, yes.
Ok I don't want to talk about it but I need you to fine me 20 Shoot's
scripts.translation: 好吧，我不想多說，但請幫我找20個樹根。

scripts.text: Have you come to check out one of these guild halls?
scripts.translation: 你是來看看這些公會大廳的嗎？

scripts.text: I'm so happy to see one of these Emperiums! Thank you {0}.
scripts.translation: 能看到一塊華麗金屬真是太高興了！謝謝你，{0}。

scripts.text: And some of my old treasure...
scripts.translation: 再收下我的一些舊寶藏...

scripts.text: I know this may sound stupid but ever since I was a boy I have dreamed of having an Emperium...
scripts.translation: 我知道這聽起來很傻，但我從小就夢想擁有一塊華麗金屬...

scripts.text: As I know I look old, I have just never been able to find one, now that I am retired from the Treasure Hunter Guild there is no more action for me...
scripts.translation: 我知道自己看起來老了，可一直沒找到過。如今我從尋寶者公會退休，再也沒機會行動了...

scripts.text: If you can get me one I shall reward you.
scripts.translation: 如果你能幫我找到一塊，我會給你報酬。

scripts.text: Oh thank you so much, but they will be back...
scripts.translation: 哦，太感謝你了，不過它們還會回來的...

scripts.text: Welcome to the Forest Maze, I have a task for you.
scripts.translation: 歡迎來到森林迷宮，我有任務交給你。

scripts.text: Ever heard of a monster called a Savage? It looks like a boar but it makes very annoying noises.
scripts.translation: 聽說過叫野豬的魔物嗎？它長得像野豬，叫聲非常煩人。

scripts.text: What I want you to do is bring me 15 Manes from the savages.
scripts.translation: 我要你從野豬身上帶回15個鬃毛。

scripts.text: Much thanks I have for you.
Take with you these 2 Treasure Token's.
Must do for me you shall.Venture through the Pyramid.
scripts.translation: 你必須替我辦件事。前往金字塔深處。

scripts.text: When second floor you have reached,slay skeletons of evil.
scripts.translation: 到達二樓後，消滅邪惡骷髏。

scripts.text: Bring me back there bones you must.
scripts.translation: 你必須把它們的骨頭帶回來。

scripts.text: I wonder what happened to my flowers
Oh are these my flower! To bad I don't want them anymore...
scripts.translation: 哦，這些是我的花嗎！可惜我已經不想要了...

scripts.text: You can keep them is you want.
Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.
scripts.translation: 拿著這枚尋寶代幣作為報酬。

scripts.text: Hello, did you bring me flowers!?!
Hello, have you seen my Whisper friend?
scripts.translation: 你好，你見過我的幽靈朋友嗎？

scripts.text: Thank you for helping me, I presume the worse.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你幫忙。我已經做好最壞的打算。

scripts.text: Hello, the reason why I brought you here was because of a long time ago I made a friend, which happened to be a Whisper.
scripts.translation: 你好，我找你來，是因為很久以前我交了一個朋友，它正好是隻幽靈。

scripts.text: He told me that he was always bullied by the other ghosts down there and I haven't seen him in a while.
scripts.translation: 它說總是被下面的其他幽靈欺負，我已經有一陣子沒見到它了。

scripts.text: Thinking of the worse case here, I want vengeance!
scripts.translation: 我擔心發生了最壞的情況，我要報仇！

scripts.text: Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.
scripts.translation: 拿著這枚尋寶代幣作為報酬。

scripts.text: Another quest for you I have.
scripts.translation: 我還有個任務要交給你。

scripts.text: Further into the pyramid you must go.
scripts.translation: 你必須繼續深入金字塔。

scripts.text: Fighting Mummies is future for you.
scripts.translation: 接下來你要和木乃伊戰鬥。

scripts.text: Bring back for me their wrappings you must.
scripts.translation: 你必須把它們的繃帶帶回來。

scripts.text: It is 30 Rotten bandages I desire.
Much thanks for you that I have.
Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.
scripts.translation: 拿著這枚尋寶代幣作為報酬。

scripts.text: One of those evil monsters has followed you up here, Kill it, Kill it!!!
scripts.translation: 有隻邪惡魔物跟著你上來了，快殺了它！！！

scripts.text: Hello, the reason I sent for a young adventurer was because of the problems we are having under the tower.
scripts.translation: 你好，我找年輕冒險者來，是因為塔下出了些問題。

scripts.text: There seem to be more ghosts day after day down there. What I need you to do is go down there and find these monsters we call Nightmares.
scripts.translation: 下面的幽靈似乎一天比一天多。我要你下去找出那些叫夢魘的魔物。

scripts.text: You must slay them and bring me 20 of there horse shoes.
scripts.translation: 殺掉它們，帶回20個馬蹄鐵。

scripts.text: Hi mister person. Can you get me some apple juice?
scripts.translation: 你好，先生，可以幫我拿些蘋果汁嗎？
你好，{0}，歡迎來到艾爾貝塔。

scripts.text: Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.
scripts.translation: 拿著這枚尋寶代幣作為報酬。

scripts.text: Well there have been reports of a Golden Thief Bug running around the bottom on the Culvert
scripts.translation: 聽說下水道底層有黃金盜蟲四處遊蕩。

scripts.text: Bring me 1 Gold Bar from him.
Thank you for helping me, I presume the worse.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你幫忙。我已經做好最壞的打算。

scripts.text: Good your here. Ok there are reports of an old captain named Drake aborted this ship. Kill Him!
scripts.translation: 你來得正好。聽說一位名叫德雷克的老船長霸佔了這艘船。把他幹掉！

scripts.text: Bring me his Saber as proof!
Hi mister person. Can you get me some Banana juice?
scripts.translation: 你好，先生，可以幫我拿些香蕉汁嗎？

scripts.text: Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.
scripts.translation: 拿著這枚尋寶代幣作為報酬。

scripts.text: Hello, have you seen my Whisper friend?
scripts.translation: 你好，你見過我的幽靈朋友嗎？

scripts.text: Thank you for helping me, I presume the worse.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你幫忙。我已經做好最壞的打算。

scripts.text: Hello,the reason why I brought you here was because of a very strange monster known as Baphomet.
scripts.translation: 你好，我找你來，是因為有一種叫巴風特的奇怪魔物。

scripts.text: People say that Baphomet guilds the gate to the under-world but I don't believe them, Kill Baphomet!
scripts.translation: 聽說巴風特守著通往冥界的大門，不過我不信。去殺了巴風特！
把它的邪惡之角帶給我！

scripts.text: Sorry I'm waiting for someone. You will have to come back later.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我在等人。你稍後再來吧。

scripts.text: Thank you for helping me, I presume the worse.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你幫忙。我已經做好最壞的打算。

scripts.text: Help, help I have lost my Beads!! My brother Bush is going to kill me please help
scripts.translation: 救命！我的玻璃珠不見了！！我哥哥布什會殺了我的，求你幫幫我！

scripts.text: Hello {0} welcome to the Mage Guild.
scripts.translation: 你好，{0}，歡迎來到魔法師公會。

scripts.text: Thank you for this delivery. Sorry about the smell, Its a box of Toad Tongues
scripts.translation: 謝謝你送來的東西。抱歉有點臭，裡面是一箱蛙肉。

scripts.text: Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.
scripts.translation: 拿著這枚尋寶代幣作為報酬。

scripts.text: Hello {0}, Where is my box of Toad Tongues?.
Sorry I'm waiting for someone, you will have to come back later
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我在等人，你稍後再來吧。

scripts.text: Help, Well what we know about Payon is that a while ago there was a freak fire that burnt down the old school.
scripts.translation: 救命...我們只知道前陣子斐揚的舊學校發生了一場怪火，被燒燬了。

scripts.text: The strange thing about what happened was that the children inside did not seem to die from the flames. They have taken over the entire 3rd floor of Payon Cave.
scripts.translation: 奇怪的是，裡面的孩子似乎沒有葬身火海。他們佔據了斐揚洞窟整個三樓。

scripts.text: Sorry I'm waiting for someone, you will have to come back later
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我在等人，你稍後再來吧。

scripts.text: Well I don't know much about this, it has to do with the deepest regions of Payon Cave. We don't know much because no one ever seems to make it back alive. We suspect a monster we call the Moonlight Flower
scripts.translation: 我不太清楚詳情，只知道和斐揚洞窟最深處有關。那裡幾乎沒人能活著回來。我們懷疑是一隻叫月夜貓的魔物在作祟。

scripts.text: Hello, we need you to investigate some crap in the 3rd level of Payon.
scripts.translation: 你好，我們需要你去調查斐揚洞窟三樓的怪事。

scripts.text: Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.
scripts.translation: 拿著這枚尋寶代幣作為報酬。

scripts.text: Sorry I'm waiting for someone, you will have to come back later
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我在等人，你稍後再來吧。

scripts.text: Tony the Tiger is on Crack! He must be stopped, KILL HIM!
scripts.translation: 老虎托尼嗑藥了！必須阻止他，殺了他！

scripts.text: Sorry I'm waiting for someone, you will have to come back later.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我在等人。你稍後再來吧。

scripts.text: Phreeoni the Pink Fluff is terrorizing little novices! He must be stopped, KILL HIM!
scripts.translation: 粉色毛球皮裡恩正在欺負初心者！必須阻止它，殺了它！

scripts.text: Sorry I'm waiting for someone, You will have to come back later
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我在等人。你稍後再來吧。

scripts.text: This half naked freak need an army to take down, now its your job,good luck.
scripts.translation: 這個半裸的怪胎得出動一支軍隊才能打倒。現在交給你了，祝你好運。
